game_title: Off By One Fixer – Stump Court Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mystic Forest – Stump Court, a court around a giant stump: the wood elf archer must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Stump Court: a court around a giant stump
core_gameplay_loop: In Stump Court, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the fixes value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about fixes to power up the wood elf archer and open the herb garden.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Off By One Fixer
